terrae: terra, -ae (f.) — earth, land, country (gen./dat. sg.; nom. pl.)
teucrum: Teucrī, -ōrum (m. pl.) — Teucrians, Trojans (gen. pl., archaic -um for -ōrum)
theatri: theātrum, -ī (n.) — theatre; spectators' hollow, amphitheatre (gen. sg.)
troiae: Trōia, -ae (f.) — Troy (gen. sg.) · also dat. sg., for Troy (sīc fāta ferēbant)
troiaque: Trōia, -ae (f.) — Troy (abl. sg.) + -que 'and' · also nom. sg. (Trōiaque … stārēs)
troïa: Trōius, -a, -um — Trojan, of Troy (n. acc. pl.; f. nom. sg.), with diaeresis ï
tulere: ferō, ferre, tulī, lātum — to bear, carry, bring (3rd pl. perf. = tulērunt)
tum: tum (adv.) — then, at that time; next
tumulum: tumulus, -ī (m.) — mound, hillock, burial mound (acc. sg.)
umida: ūmidus, -a, -um — damp, moist, dewy (f. nom. sg.; n. nom./acc. pl.)
una: ūnus, -a, -um — one, a single (f. abl./nom. sg.); ūnā (adv.), together · also ūnā, adv., once (satis ūnā superque, enough once and more)
ut: ut (conj.) — + subj. so that, in order that; + indic. as, when, how
variis: varius, -a, -um — varied, many-coloured, diverse (m./f./n. abl./dat. pl.)
vel: vel (conj., adv.) — or; even; vel… vel, either… or
vero: vērō (adv.) — in truth, indeed, but; tum vērō, then indeed
vertitur: vertō, vertere, vertī, versum — to turn; vertitur, wheels round (3rd sg. pres. pass.)
vestras: vester, vestra, vestrum — your (pl.) (f. acc. pl.)
vi: vīs (f.; acc. vim, abl. vī) — force, power, violence (abl. sg.)
videt: videō, vidēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see, behold (3rd sg. pres.)
virgulta: virgultum, -ī (n.) — brushwood, shrub, shoots (nom./acc. pl.; usually plural)
visa: videō, vidēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see (perf. pass. part., f. nom. sg.; n. nom./acc. pl.)
vobis: tū, tuī — you; vōs, vōbīs, to/for you, by you (dat./abl. pl.)
vocati: vocō, -āre, -āvī, -ātum — to call, summon (perf. pass. part., m. nom. pl.)
voltus: vultus (voltus), -ūs (m.) — face, look, expression (nom. sg.; acc. pl.) · also nom. pl. (haerent … voltus)
vox: vōx, vōcis (f.) — voice, word, sound (nom. sg.)
